description:
This file defines a custom exception class `InvalidURLException` within the `OrangeHRM uzz
Exception` namespace. The class provides static methods to generate exceptions for invalid URLs from YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion platforms. It is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system and is intended for error handling related to URL validation in the Buzz plugin component.

classes.name: InvalidURLException
classes.description: A custom exception class for invalid URL errors, providing specific static methods for different video platform URL validation errors.

methods.name: invalidYouTubeURLProvided
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception indicating an invalid YouTube URL.

methods.name: invalidVimeoURLProvided
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception indicating an invalid Vimeo URL.

methods.name: invalidDailymotionURLProvided
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception indicating an invalid Dailymotion URL.
